notes.title: UPDATE
notes.notes: Additional animations, sound effects, balance tweeks and difficulty changes, bug fixes, performance optimization, controls tuning and bigger cursor. Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: New Update! Alternative control modes to choose from.
notes.notes:
- Alternative controls. There is original, casual and WASD control modes in Settings->Controls menu.
- Camera rotation.
- Sniper rifle zoom out.
- Credits in main menu.
- Corrupted/edited savegames would not break main menu.
